articles.title: Crypto traders are in risk-on mode as bitcoin dominance nears return to 60%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin dominance is closing in on 60% while USDT's has slipped to 6.3%, pointing to a market growing more comfortable with risk.

articles.title: US Designates Russia's A7 Network as Transnational Criminal Organization
articles.snippet: Treasury's proposed rule aims to cut A7's front companies off from U.S. finance—including crypto, where its ruble token moved $179 billion.
